تكتنزون (form VIII)
# تَكْتَنِزُونَ (taktanizūna) /tak.ta.ni.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# تُكْتَنَزُونَ (tuktanazūna) /tuk.ta.na.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
